basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI upgrade icon, ONE isolated object centered on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. Single square icon, no grid. Approved style E: premium gritty retrofuturistic military equipment miniature, worn olive green painted metal, chipped edges, weathered dark steel, brass, warm amber orange warning lights, tactile hand-painted volumetric look, bold readable silhouette and dark outline, soft top-left light, three-quarter view. Match the RIGHT side E of reference sheet for materials and rendering, but render ONLY the requested subject. Entire object and effects contained in central 80 percent of square with at least 10 percent transparent padding each side. No scenery, no ground plane or cast shadow on background, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no plus badge, no watermark. Large simple forms readable at 64px; avoid tiny clutter. Cursed subjects use dark crimson and black instead of amber. Subject:
